source_doc.title: HD Hyundai Electric Expands U.S. Production Subsidiary, Solidifies Leadership in North American Extra High Voltage Power Transformer Market（2026-03-07）
source_doc.publisher: PR Newswire（news provided by HD Hyundai）
source_doc.permission_basis: 發行人公開新聞稿；只保留研究必要的逐字摘錄。

sources.quote: HD Hyundai Electric will invest approximately $200 million to increase extra high voltage power transformer production capacity by 50% and establish manufacturing and testing capabilities for 765-kilovolt-class transformers
a second plant at its North American production base, HD Hyundai Power Transformers USA, in Montgomery, Alabama
This localized production base has significantly reduced supply lead times and enhanced customer responsiveness, strengthening trust and order competitiveness in the North American market.
will be constructed within the site of the North American production subsidiary, with completion targeted for April next year.
Revenue increased from approximately $100 million in 2017 to about $400 million in 2025.

claims.statement: Issuer plan (2026-03-07): HD Hyundai Electric is investing about $200 million in a second plant at HD Hyundai Power Transformers USA (Montgomery, Alabama) to raise extra-high-voltage power transformer capacity by 50% and add 765 kV-class manufacturing and testing, completion targeted for April 2027; it says the localized base 'significantly reduced supply lead times', and the subsidiary's revenue grew from about $100 million (2017) to about $400 million (2025). Supply is being added — the volume window for this layer narrows when it lands. Self-report (L8: weak); dated (L4).
claims.disproof_condition: 條件：HD 現代電氣公告 Montgomery 第二廠延後、縮小或取消，或 2027 年中仍未取得 765kV 級試驗能力。核查頻率：每季（DART、公司新聞稿）。觸發後 48 小時：本 claim 加註，LPT 讀圖重估量的窗口。
